post.summary: Starts a new user session.
post.description: Before being able to use the API, you need to log in and get a valid token.

401.description: Invalid credentials or the provided token is not valid.

403.description: Provided token does not have permissions to perform operation

400.description: Malformed request. For example, you didn’t provide email and password fields.

503.description: If the application is suspended or in maintenance mode.

post.summary: Finishes the current user session.
post.description: Revokes current session's token.

parameters.description: Access token to perform operation.

get.summary: Lists users in the app.
get.description: Lists existing users in the app.

parameters.name: token
parameters.description: Access token to perform operation.

parameters.name: firstName
parameters.description: Allows to filter by first name doing a partial match.

parameters.name: lastName
parameters.description: Allows to filter by last name doing a partial match.

parameters.name: fullName
parameters.description: Allows to filter by full name doing a partial match.

parameters.name: email
parameters.description: Allows to filter by email a partial match.

parameters.name: developer
parameters.description: Allows to filter by developers. You can pass true or false, or leave it empty to get all.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Allows to filter by the status. You can pass many statuses separated by commas. Possible values are ACTIVE, INACTIVE and BLOCKED.

parameters.name: groups
parameters.description: Allows to filter by group label doing a partial match. You can specify many values separated by commas.

parameters.name: size
parameters.description: The maximum number of users to retrieve.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: This is the offset to start getting users. When you make a query you will get the offset you need to use to get more users.

total.description: The total number of records matched.

offset.description: The offset to pass to get more records.

items.description: This is the list of records fetched.

put.summary: Adds an identity provider for a user to allow logging in with it.
put.description: Sets an identity provider for a user to allow logging in with it.

parameters.description: Access token to perform operation.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The ID, email or external ID of the user to perform operation.

id.description: The ID of the identity provider to add. Either the id or the name of the identity provider is needed.

name.description: The name of the identity provider to add. Either the id or the name of the identity provider is needed.

externalId.description: The ID of the user in the identity provider. You can leave it empty and when the user logs in with this identity provider it should be set.

responses.400: Invalid information for the new identity provider.
